notes.title: 🐎 Storm Horse Simulator — Dev Log 001: Our Wild Journey Begins!
notes.content:
[h2]🐎 Storm Horse Simulator — Dev Log 001: Our Wild Journey Begins![/h2][p]Hello everyone, and welcome to our very first dev log for [i]Spirit Horse Simulator[/i]! 🌄✨[/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally share a behind-the-scenes look at what we’ve been working on — and to bring you along for this wild ride from the very beginning.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌿 [b]What is Storm Horse Simulator?[/b][/h3][p]In [i]Storm Horse Simulator[/i], you step into the hooves of a free-spirited horse exploring a vast, living world. Gallop across breathtaking open landscapes, survive the challenges of nature, bond with your herd, and discover your own unique path through the wilderness.[/p][p]It’s more than just a simulation — it’s about living the untamed life of a wild horse and experiencing the true spirit of freedom and adventure.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🐴 [b]How Far Along Are We?[/b][/h3][p]We’re excited to share that about [b]60% of the game is already complete![/b] 🙌[/p][p]Our team has been hard at work developing:
✅ [b]Open World Environments[/b] — Lush forests, open plains, rivers, and hidden trails that feel alive and immersive.
✅ [b]Realistic Horse Movement & Animation[/b] — From galloping and grazing to authentic herd behaviors, your horse feels expressive and real.
✅ [b]Herd & Wildlife AI[/b] — The world is filled with dynamic herds and other animals, adding surprise and life to every area.
✅ [b]Weather & Day/Night Cycle[/b] — Changing weather and time of day bring a sense of realism and new challenges.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681610/bc623952b76048cb50863dd7cd1bec55f5de1610.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔭 [b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3][p]We’re now focusing on the next big steps:
🌟 [b]Expanding the world[/b] — We’re working on [b]new locations and biomes[/b] for you to explore.
🌟 [b]Designing new quests[/b] — To give players meaningful goals, surprises, and choices along their journey.
🌟 [b]Polishing survival elements and customization[/b] — Making sure the gameplay stays fresh and rewarding.
🌟 [b]Preparing an early build[/b] — We can’t wait to share it with you and hear your thoughts!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681610/1e04a86f73cc565e204ec3eb76e0ce05fb3d09cb.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🤝 [b]Join Us on This Adventure![/b][/h3][p]This is just the beginning — and we’d love to take this journey together. We’ll be sharing regular dev logs, concept art, and behind-the-scenes peeks as we continue to grow [i]Spirit Horse Simulator[/i] into something truly special for horse lovers and adventure fans alike.[/p][p]💬 [b]Don’t forget to join our Discord channel for the latest news, sneak peeks, and community chats:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/mYvv2PmNnw"]https://discord.gg/mYvv2PmNnw[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback and support mean so much to us. And don’t forget to [b]wishlist [i]Spirit Horse Simulator[/i] on Steam[/b] to stay updated![/p][p]Run free, stay wild — and we’ll see you in the next dev log! 🐎💨✨[/p][p]— [i]The Spirit Horse Simulator Team[/i][/p]
